build_RayMarcher: build a RayMarcher module to render RGBA images from 3D primitives and camera parameters
run_RayMarcher_forward: run the RayMarcher forward pass with primitive RGBA, positions, rotations, scales, and camera intrinsics
create_subsample_pixel_coords: create a function to randomly subsample pixel coordinates for training-time ray sampling
create_resize_pixel_coords: create a function to deterministically downsample pixel coordinates for inference-time rendering
generate_colored_boxes: generate colored 3D box templates with diffuse lighting for debugging volumetric rendering
